Auto-generated from CLI schemas. Use `ai-happy-design schema <command> --json` for machine-readable format.

## effect.add_shadow

Add a drop shadow to a node

Aliases: `shadow`

### Parameters

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|-------|------|----------|---------|-------------|-------------|
| nodeId | string | yes |  | pattern: ^[0-9]+:[0-9]+$ |  |
| color | string |  | #00000040 | pattern: ^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{3,8}$ | Shadow color hex |
| offsetX | number |  | 0 |  | Horizontal offset |
| offsetY | number |  | 4 |  | Vertical offset |
| radius | number |  | 4 | 0-200 | Blur radius |
| spread | number |  | 0 | -100-100 | Spread distance |
| type | string |  | DROP_SHADOW | DROP_SHADOW/INNER_SHADOW |  |

## node.create_frame

Create a frame (Figma's equivalent of a div)

Aliases: `frame`

### Parameters

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|-------|------|----------|---------|-------------|-------------|
| name | string |  |  |  | Semantic name for the frame (never leave as default) |
| parentId | string |  |  | pattern: ^[0-9]+:[0-9]+$ | Parent node ID (alias: pid) |
| x | number |  |  |  | X position |
| y | number |  |  |  | Y position |
| width | number |  |  | 1-10000 | Frame width (alias: w) |
| height | number |  |  | 1-10000 | Frame height (alias: h) |
| color | string |  |  | pattern: ^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{3,8}$ | Fill color hex (NOT fillColor) (alias: bg) |
| cornerRadius | number |  |  | 0-500 | Corner radius (alias: r) |
| opacity | number |  |  | 0-1 | Opacity |
| layoutMode | string |  |  | HORIZONTAL/VERTICAL | Auto-layout direction |
| itemSpacing | number |  |  | 0-500 | Spacing between auto-layout children |
| padding | number |  |  | 0-500 | Uniform padding for all sides |
| paddingTop | number |  |  | 0-500 |  |
| paddingRight | number |  |  | 0-500 |  |
| paddingBottom | number |  |  | 0-500 |  |
| paddingLeft | number |  |  | 0-500 |  |
| primaryAxisAlignItems | string |  |  | MIN/CENTER/MAX/SPACE_BETWEEN |  |
| counterAxisAlignItems | string |  |  | MIN/CENTER/MAX/BASELINE |  |
| layoutSizingHorizontal | string |  |  | FIXED/HUG/FILL |  |
| layoutSizingVertical | string |  |  | FIXED/HUG/FILL |  |
| layoutWrap | string |  |  | WRAP/NO_WRAP |  |
| clipsContent | boolean |  |  |  | Whether children clip to frame bounds |
| structural | boolean |  |  |  | Structural frame: removes default fill, enables clipping. Use for wrappers and auto-layout containers. |
| stroke | string |  |  | pattern: ^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{3,8}$ | Stroke color hex |
| strokeWeight | number |  |  | 0-100 |  (alias: sw) |
| minWidth | number |  |  | 0-10000 | Minimum width (auto-layout children only) |
| maxWidth | number |  |  | 0-10000 | Maximum width (auto-layout children only) |
| minHeight | number |  |  | 0-10000 | Minimum height (auto-layout children only) |
| maxHeight | number |  |  | 0-10000 | Maximum height (auto-layout children only) |
